alt: Review Exercise 3 · Q14: A shopping mall has 100 products from various categories labeled 1 to 100, representing the universal set U. The products are categorized as follows: Set A: Electronics, consisting of 30 products labeled from 1 to 30. Set B: Clothing comprises 25 products labeled from 31 to 55. Set C: Beauty Products, comprising 25 products labeled from 76 to 100. Write each set in tabular form, and find the union of all three sets.

steps.title: Solution
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&U=\{1,2,3,\ldots ,100\}\\[5pt]&A=\{1,2,3,\ldots ,30\}\text{ (n(A) }=30)\\[5pt]&B=\{31,32,33,\ldots ,55\}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(n(B) }=55-31+1=25)\\[5pt]&C=\{76,77,78,\ldots ,100\}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(n(C) }=100-76+1=25)\\[5pt]&A\cup B\cup C=\{1,2,3,\ldots ,55\}\cup \\[5pt]&\quad \{76,77,\ldots ,100\}\\[5pt]&=\{1,2,3,\ldots ,55,76,77,\ldots ,100\}\\[5pt]&\text{The three sets are disjoint, so}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{n(A }\cup B\cup \text{ C) }=30+25+25=80\\[5pt]&\text{(The products labelled }56\text{ to }75,\text{ i.e. }20\text{ products, are in none of the three sets.)}\end{aligned}\]
